Subject: LegacyBank - On-prem air-gapped deployment qualification

Hi Bob / Sarah,

Thanks again for the call today

really helpful to understand LegacyBank's constraints and goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can validate feasibility for an air-gapped on-prem deployment: 

Summary of requirements from today
- Full air-gapped environment (no outbound internet from the inference cluster)
- Hardware: planning initially for ~2 racks; target throughput ~120 qps (chat) with 8k context.
- Strict patching/upgrade windows; upgrades must be demonstrably offline and reversible.
- KMS integration via HSM (customer-managed).
- Audit logs and SOC2 evidence required.

Action items / ask from LegacyBank: 
1) Hardware baseline: can you share the existing GPU model(s) you plan to use (make/model, memory)?
2) Upgrade cadence & maintenance windows: typical maintenance blackout periods and how upgrades are approved.
3) Network diagram for the air-gapped segment (we only need the boundaries and jump-hosts).
4) Procurement POC / contact for any paperwork.

I've attached a short checklist (redwood-onprem-checklist.pdf) to make it easier to fill in. If you can send the items above, I'll loop in our private deployment engineering lead (Dev) and solutions architect (Jonas) to produce a short runbook and an offline upgrade playbook tailored to your environment.

Proposed next step: schedule a 30-45 minute technical deep-dive next week (we recommend including your security/ops lead). Are you available Wed/Thu next week?

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Marissa,

Thanks for the clear notes

appreciate the checklist. Quick responses below and I've attached a network diagram to illustrate our air-gapped segment.

Hardware baseline:
- We have a mix right now; preferred target for the POC is NVIDIA A100 80GB (x8 per rack). We can also provision A40s if capacity constrained.

Upgrade windows / process:
- Regular maintenance windows: Saturday 02:00-06:00 local. Emergency patches can be scheduled but require CTO approval.
- Upgrades must be deliverable via media (USB/OVF) since nodes have no outbound. We also require signed manifests for any software.

KMS / HSM:
- We run an on-prem HSM (Thales) and will want KMS integration; we need details on key wrapping and export controls.

Network diagram:
- See attachment (legacybank-net-diagram.png) - there's a bastion that can import media and verify signatures.

Procurement contact:
- procurement@legacybank.com (CC'd) - they'll coordinate SOW and PO.

Happy to set up the technical deep-dive - Wed (10th) after 11am PT works for us.

Best,

Hi team / Marissa,

Thanks - see answers below which we can surface in the customer meeting. I've attached a draft runbook (private-deploy-runbook-v1.docx) with more detail. High level:

1) Supported hardware
- Primary: NVIDIA A100 80GB (we validate with 8x per rack test configs).
- Fallback: NVIDIA A40 or similar; performance and memory differ, we'll provide explicit perf guidance and model-quantization profiles.

2) Offline upgrades / media-only installs
- We support delivering signed offline bundles (tar + manifest + signature). Customer imports via bastion; our install agent verifies signatures using an offline trust chain (X.509 signing key).
- Upgrade procedure: staging environment -> snapshot -> apply upgrade -> smoke tests -> commit. Each step can be performed offline; rollback uses stored snapshots.
- We provide a verified checksum and signature for every binary and model shard.

3) KMS / HSM integration
- We support integration with common HSMs (Thales, nCipher) via an on-prem KMS adapter. Keys are wrapped locally; private keys never leave HSM.
- Key rotation: customer-managed; we support rotation hooks and re-encryption steps in the runbook.

4) Monitoring & telemetry
- For air-gapped setups we recommend a local Prometheus/Grafana stack and periodic export packages (encrypted) that can be transferred out-of-band for audit. We provide exporters and an audit-log format compatible with SOC2 evidence requirements.

5) Recommended next steps for POC
- We propose: 1 rack with 4x A100 80GB for a 2-week POC (throughput baseline + failover tests), and a defined test plan (we include readiness checklist + rollback tests).
- We'll prepare an offline image bundle and runbook for your bastion team to verify signatures during the POC.

Let me know if you want any of the technical sections expanded before Wed's meeting. Happy to join the call and walk through the runbook.

Regards,
Dev Patel
Private Deployments Lead | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
